label: U.S. real 10-year yield
transformation: 10-year Treasury yield minus U.S. CPI inflation

label: U.S. real 10-year yield, gap
transformation: real 10-year yield minus its one-sided HP trend (lambda 100)

label: U.S. 3-month T-bill rate, gap
transformation: 3-month Treasury bill rate minus its one-sided HP trend (lambda 100)

label: Real deposit rate, change
transformation: 1-year change in the real deposit rate (log rates: deposit rate minus inflation)

label: Total debt / GDP, 3-year change
transformation: 3-year change in private plus central government debt (percent of GDP)

label: Credit gap
transformation: bank credit to GDP minus its one-sided HP trend (lambda 1600)

label: Output gap
transformation: log real GDP (cumulated growth) minus its one-sided HP trend (lambda 100)

label: External debt / exports
transformation: external debt (percent of GNI) divided by exports (percent of GDP)
